question: Who among the following wrote in calligraphic style the Hindi version of the original Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vasant Krishan Vaidya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vasant Krishan Vaidya:-**

 
 
• **He was a renowned Indian calligrapher.**
 
• **He was responsible for the calligraphy of the Hindi version of the original Constitution of India. **
 
• He worked on the project for six months, using hundreds of pen nibs to create the intricate and beautiful calligraphy.
 
• He was born in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, and began learning calligraphy at a young age.
 
• He was known for his flowing and elegant calligraphy style, which he developed by studying the works of ancient Indian calligraphers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prem Behari Narain Raizada:-**

 
 
• **He was an Indian calligrapher who is best known for writing the original Constitution of India in English. **
 
• He was born in Delhi, India, into a family of calligraphers.
 
• His grandfather, Seth Govind Ram, was a renowned calligrapher who taught him the art of calligraphy.
 
 
 
• **Nandalal Bose:-**
 
 
• **He was one of the pioneers of modern Indian art. **
 
• He was born in Kharagpur, Bihar, India, into a Bengali family.
 
• He studied art at the Government Art College, Calcutta, where he was a student of Abanindranath Tagore.
